description: 캐릭터별 기본 스탯 및 고유 메카닉. StS 캐릭터 설계 기준.

mugwan.description_ko: 높은 HP와 공격력. 힘 버프를 쌓아 폭딜하는 직관적 캐릭터.
mugwan.description_en: High HP and damage. Stacks Strength for burst damage.
mugwan.playstyle: Ironclad-style. Self-heal, Strength scaling, Exhaust synergy.

mungwan.description_ko: 약화·취약 디버프와 광역 공격. 적을 제압하는 전략가.
mungwan.description_en: Weak/Vulnerable debuffs and AoE. Controls the battlefield.
mungwan.playstyle: Silent-style. Poison, Weak stacking, card draw engine.

dosa.description_ko: 화상·독 DoT와 저주로 적을 서서히 태우는 술법사.
dosa.description_en: Burns and poisons enemies with DoT and curses.
dosa.playstyle: DoT specialist. Burn/Poison stacking, indirect damage.

uiwon.description_ko: 자가 회복과 독을 겸비한 지구전 전문가.
uiwon.description_en: Self-healing and Poison. Outlasts enemies through sustain.
uiwon.playstyle: Sustain/Poison hybrid. HP recovery, long fights.

gungsu.description_ko: 다중 타격과 카드 드로우. 한 턴에 많은 카드를 쏟아내는 콤보형.
gungsu.description_en: Multi-hit and card draw. Plays many cards per turn.
gungsu.playstyle: Shiv/multi-hit style. Card draw engine, 0-cost cards.

sangin.description_ko: 높은 방어도와 반격. 수비하며 적을 압도하는 탱커.
sangin.description_en: High Block and counterattacks. Defends and overwhelms.
sangin.playstyle: Barricade/Body Slam style. Block retention, counter damage.
